name: VILLE DU HAVRE
confidence: high; see the notes on bar 7 and the refrain
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (The Evangelical Hymnal, 1921); the opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit.
reviewNotes: High for the notes. The refrain is the soprano line only (the men's echo 'it is well' is not shown); 'well' and 'soul' in the refrain are held six beats. Many books print the tune in C; this source has Db, with the same solfa.
